stat.health.name: Health
stat.health.long: Hit points. When a damage roll meets or beats this, you're knocked out.
stat.health.short: HP — meet or beat it to KO.

stat.armor.name: Armor
stat.armor.long: Armor Class. An attacker's first roll must meet or beat this to land a hit.
stat.armor.short: AC — beat it to land a hit.

stat.speed.name: Speed
stat.speed.long: Sets turn order — higher speed acts earlier in the round.

offensive.killingMomentum.name: Killing Momentum
offensive.killingMomentum.long: If you knock out an opponent, immediately attack another player of your choice.
offensive.killingMomentum.short: KO an opponent, then attack another.

offensive.allIn.name: All-In
offensive.allIn.long: Activated. Roll 1d6: on 5–6 attack twice this round; on 1 you knock yourself out; 2–4 no effect.

offensive.prepareAttack.name: Prepare Attack
offensive.prepareAttack.long: Activated. Roll 2d6 — a 10, 11 or 12 knocks the target out.

offensive.summonMinion.name: Summon Minion
offensive.summonMinion.long: Activated. Roll 1d6 to raise a skeleton or golem (and sometimes heal). Minions add a shield and an extra attack.
offensive.summonMinion.short: Roll 1d6 to raise a minion (shield + extra attack).

offensive.encore.name: Encore
offensive.encore.long: After dealing damage, roll 1d6 — on a 5 or 6, attack again.

offensive.impersonate.name: Impersonate
offensive.impersonate.long: Activated. Copy a living opponent's offensive ability until you choose another.

offensive.spellPotency.name: Spell Potency
offensive.spellPotency.long: Roll doubles to hit or damage: deal the dice total to the target and half to every other opponent, then end your turn.
offensive.spellPotency.short: Doubles: full damage to target, half to all.

defensive.dodge.name: Dodge
defensive.dodge.long: Each time an attacker fails to break your armor, gain +1 Armor (up to +2) for the match.

defensive.luckyCoin.name: Lucky Coin
defensive.luckyCoin.long: When your armor is broken, add 1d6 to Armor until turn end; on a 6, deal 1d6 back to the attacker.

defensive.riposte.name: Riposte
defensive.riposte.long: When an opponent passes your armor, roll 2d6 — on a 6, 7 or 8 you turn the attack back on them.
defensive.riposte.short: Pass armor: 6–8 turns it back on them.

defensive.persuade.name: Persuade
defensive.persuade.long: When your armor is passed, roll 1d6 — on a 5 stop the attack; on a 6 redirect it to another target.

defensive.mirrorImage.name: Mirror Image
defensive.mirrorImage.long: Once per attack phase, reroll one die and subtract 1 (result can be 0). Not usable on special-ability damage.
defensive.mirrorImage.short: Reroll a die at −1, once per phase.

defensive.teleport.name: Teleport
defensive.teleport.long: When your armor is passed, roll off 1d6 with the attacker — roll higher to escape the attack.
defensive.teleport.short: Passed armor: roll higher to escape.

defensive.holyShield.name: Holy Shield
defensive.holyShield.long: Once per match, when knocked out roll 2d6 — on 10–12 survive at 1 HP and deal 1d6 unblockable to the attacker.
